race.comment: WICKED LEGEND (3) moderate effort at this track two runs ago then settled back and failed to figure at his latest appearance over 1609m at this track, beaten 3.5 metres into third. Has the benefit of a good draw. Meets a comparable field and he can figure in the finish. SOFT LANDING (1) scored at this track three runs ago but has been unplaced in two subsequent runs, the latest when sixth over 1609m at this track, beaten 35 metres. A nice draw on the front line should ensure a cosy run. Meets a similar line up and is capable of another bold performance. SUPERIOR ART (9) must be considered after he finished runner-up over 1609m at this track a week ago. HEAVEN FAST (4) is worth some thought after her last-start fourth over 1609m at this track on October 1.
